title: Compatibility checks see text forms, edge targets and cardinality
summary: The language compatibility index now records each text field's form and each edge rule's target and cardinality, so the release gate classes a base that adds or changes a form, narrows a cardinality or retargets an edge rule as breaking, and three edge rules that share a predicate are compared separately instead of as one. `ia floor` reports a value outside a base's text form as a `form` gap. When a base changes, the gate also proves the three published public kits (ia-authoring, ia-kb, ia-method) with `ia floor --verify`, beside the method fixture kit.
